title: Use Seedance 2.5 on CapCut PC to continue the shared official opening clip into…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 on CapCut PC to continue the shared official opening clip into an original narrative that’s 3 minutes or longer.  
Structure a longer entry before generating more clips; plan the story beats first, then prompt each shot.  
Leverage Seedance 2.5’s native up-to-30-second scene generation to let actions/conflicts/reveals develop within a single scene.  
Use timestamp instructions to schedule character entrances, camera direction changes, and reveal moments within the generated scene.  
After generating core scenes, assemble the final piece in CapCut PC’s multi-track timeline by arranging dialogue, captions, music, sound effects, and transitions to match the emotional arc and pacing.
